title: Split BACKLOG-RULES by trigger
goal: A PR reads only the backlog rules its change triggers
acceptance: One file per trigger (record fields, closure, review, plans, queue, prerequisites) with an index
Checker-enforced prose replaced by the checker command; what no checker covers stays; traceability rows
privacy: Rule and tool text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: Any requirement that would be dropped rather than moved goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
